描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. mobile phones with dual sim card slot, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. the mobile phones with dual sim card slot were suggested by ffixxed, an art and design consultancy run by kain picken and fiona lau in shenzhen. for the two designers, ‘the dual sim function addresses the problems of cross-border incompatibility between the shenzhen and hong kong phone networks.’ this shanzhai design removes the need for two separate phones for the many people who shuttle between the two cities. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. the shenzhen exhibition was the first opportunity to test rapid response collecting. it runs an android operating system and unlike the iphone, features a removable back to allow access to the sim card slots and battery. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. mobile phones such as these are the product of the shanzhai industry of fakes that has been key to shenzhen’s manufacturing success. this fake iphone 5s imitate the look of apple’s iconic smartphone, but arguably improve on the original by integrating a double sim card slot. this design removes the need for two separate phones for the many people who shuttle between shenzhen and hong kong. this new approach to collecting is intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change.
描述_ZN: 博物馆要求深圳的60多人提出一个讲述他们城市故事的设计品，结果是一个由23件东西和23个地方的故事组成的展览。 博物馆在2014年7月开放了自己的空间，专门用于快速反应收藏。 参加双城双年展的邀请使博物馆能够参与到这个快速变化的城市中，并对最近推出的快速反应收藏系列进行测试。 带双卡槽的手机，2013年，在深圳第五届城市与建筑双年展上展出的 "V&A：快速反应的收集 "中收集，深圳价值工厂。 带有双卡槽的手机是由ffixxed建议的，这是一家由Kain picken和Fiona lau在深圳经营的艺术和设计咨询公司。 对于这两位设计师来说，"双卡功能解决了深圳和香港电话网络之间的跨境不兼容问题。"这个山寨设计消除了许多穿梭于两个城市的人对两个独立电话的需求。 今天，深圳是世界上第三繁忙的集装箱港口，人口平均年龄不到30岁，几乎完全由新移民组成。 深圳，中国的第一个经济特区，位于珠江三角洲的顶端。 深圳的展览是测试快速反应收集的第一个机会。 它运行的是安卓操作系统，与苹果手机不同的是，它有一个可拆卸的背面，可以接触到SIM卡插槽和电池。 通过展出日常用品，展览将城市生活、工业以及商业和社会变革的现实置于中心位置。 通过制造业、贸易和不懈的商业活力，该城市在短短35年内从一个普通的渔镇发展成为一个拥有1500多万人口的庞大的大都市。 像这样的手机是山寨假货产业的产物，是深圳制造业成功的关键。 这个假的iphone5s模仿了苹果标志性的智能手机的外观，但可以说是通过整合双sim卡插槽来改进原版。 这种设计消除了许多穿梭于深圳和香港之间的人对两个独立手机的需求。 这种新的收藏方法旨在使博物馆收藏对全球事件有更多的反应，并将设计与政治或社会变革的时刻直接联系起来。
